Intruders! Intruders!\nKeep them off the cocoon!!
I wonder what they meant when they said cocoon...
Whoaaa!! Adventurer, this is bad!!
Whoa?!
What's going on...
Who're you? Oh my, you're a human.\nMa'am Hydra, there's a human.
You idiot! That's riducul... Oh?
I think... I've seen you before.\nYou're managing the Garden of Beginning,\nright?
Ah, yes. Nice to see you again, Ma'am Hydra.
Why are you here?\nAnd... Who's this?
This adventurer was saved from danger and\nbrought to the Dark Realm by Grecia.
The adventurer has saved Dunkelis at Grecia's\nrequest. Then, Dunkelis asked the adventurer to\nrescue Vatendeth. That's why we're here...
What?! You saved Dunkelis?\nYou're a human, right?!\nThat's incredible...
Grecia expected much from you, and you met her\nexpectation. You sure are a great person.
Oh? Ah, let me introduce her to you.\nShe is also a Dark Captain of the Dark Troops like\nBurnos...
I'm Hydra.\nPeople call me the Dark Captain of Water...
And that's my subordinate, Bongea, a dark soldier\nof sand.
Maam, the black things are gone from their bodies.\nThe crystals are weak to water just as we thought!
Got it.\nTake care of them when they wake up...
We should have noticed it earlier...
Huh? Oh, the black crystals disappear when\nthey're exposed to a lot of water.
We couldn't even create a crack with powerful\nweapons, so I didn't try my water skill.\nThat was a big blind spot...
Come to think of it, Zolban's black crystals\ndisappeared when he plunged into the lake...\nThe black crystals are weak to water for sure...
By the way, you came to rescue Vatendeth, right?\nWe've got a clue about the place where he's being\nheld captive. It should be there...
We know it's been there since we got here...
And everytime we try to get in,\nthe mutant soldiers stand in our way.\nThey sure don't want us to step into there...
A-Adventurer, isn't that the cocoon the\nmutant soldier was talking about...?
Aww... This looks absolutely dangerous...\nWhat should we do?
You're still here?!\nHow many times do you want us to beat ya?!
Wait, Bongea. Look at the color of their bodies.\nThey're the guards of the manor. They've been\ncontrolled by the crystals. They're tough to beat.
Hey, you've gotta deal with them if you wanna\nrescue Vatendeth, you know?\nCan you give me a hand?
Alright. That's the spirit!\nBongea, attack first!!
Yes, ma'am!!
Phew, great job.\nNow we can enter.\nLet's go.
This is great, isn’t it, adventurer?\nI’m sure Sir Vatendeth could be rescued\nif they’re with us.
Whoa?!
No!! Ma'am, are you alright?!
I'm alright...\nBongea, try get close to the entrance.
Me?! ...Yes, ma'am.
Daarghhh!
Hmm, I got it...\nWe are not welcomed...
I have no idea who's in there but they\nmight've seen us remove the black crystals\nwith water...
The black crystals are weak to water.\nI'm the Dark Captain of Water and Bongea can store\nwater. So, they don't want us to get in.
Gosh!
It can't be helped.\nI'll call backup...
What?!
You're gonna get in alone?!
Don't be ridiculous! It's too dangerous!!
I know someone has to get in there to rescue Sir\nVatendeth but...\nLooks like you're not gonna change your mind...
Alright. I'll bring backup for sure, so do not\ndie until then. Got it?
Adventurer, wait for me! I'm going with you!\n...What? Yes, you might no longer need the\ncharm but I've come this far with you.
Please allow me to help you rescue Sir Vatendeth!!
Alright then, we'll hurry to call help.\nLet's go!
Yes, ma'am!!
Sir Vatendeth! Are you alright?!
Yea, it still hurts though...
Astounding! Humans like you actually rescued\nSir Vatendeth! It's incredible!
Vatendeth!! Are you alright?!
Goddess Dunkelis! ...I must apologize.\nThe Dark General shouldn't have got caught by the\nenemies that easily...
It's okay. As long as you're safe...
Hey, we shouldn't stare at them now, should we?
By the way, you're too great.\nThe backups aren't even here yet...
By the way, you're too great.\nThe backups aren't even here yet...\nOh, there they are, finally...
Ma'am!\nThe dark castle has been...\ncompletely occupied by the enemies!
What did you say?!
What about Grecia?!\nShe was supposed to be in the castle, right?!
Grecia tried to stop the enemies but there were\ntoo many foes. And we couldn't confirm if she's\nsafe...
What in the...
EVENT BATTLE\nDefeat the two guards!!
Hey, where are you goin'?!
Protect Dunkelis... Understood?
Y-Yes, sir!
Wait, you're not in tip-top condition...
I am the Dark General...
...Then, I command you as a goddess.\nCome back safe, Dark General...\nOkay?
